Count-weighted EFC = sum(count*depthPct/100). Illustrative depth dose/index = sum(count*(depthPct/100)^exponent), not measured damage or a calibrated degradation curve. Support is a separate descriptive breadth score, not confidence/pack health.

Explicit ordered finite timestamps and end <= frozen mount clock required. Finite SoC includes real 0 and 100; null/omitted endpoints excluded, not replaced by zero. Drive net drop and charging net gain must exceed 0.05 percentage points. Duration does not synthesize completion.

Continuity breaks strictly above seven days or five SoC percentage points; selected deep threshold uses >=. Full/half weights are 1/0.5. Mean and nearest-rank median/p90 use cycle-count weights. Deep share divides by weighted count; deep EFC share by EFC; index/EFC and residue share guard positive denominators. Empty means/shares/quantiles are null; known modeled sums can be zero. Disclosure mismatch is CSQA-05.

Model uses SoC endpoints and times, not outside/inside temperature, energy, power, current, chemistry, pack capacity, dwell or laboratory degradation. No temperature-derived stress or physical heat-dose claim is made; temperature preference conversion is not required for nonexistent temperature readings.

Duration is seconds in model; milliseconds conversion is display-only. SoC/depth are percent/percentage points; share/EFC/index/count are dimensionless. Depth is absolute endpoint difference after direction eligibility. No physical SI energy/power/temperature value is converted or inferred from SoC; negative energy/regen sign assumptions are not introduced.

Both consumed history paths match current registrations: /charging and /drives, snake_case vehicle_id, independently clamped 1-1000 limit, separate cache keys, vehicle enablement, forwarded AbortSignal, MODERATE stale time and safeArray select. Client supplies API prefix and exposes original snake_case plus camelCase aliases. Drive start_ts/end_ts/start_battery_pct/end_battery_pct therefore support consumed camelCase reads; charging uses original started_at/ended_at/start_soc_pct/end_soc_pct. Source contract match is not an exercised HTTP/producer contract.

/cycle-stress has vehicle=true and range=false by actual route/scope source. It intentionally analyzes separate bounded returned histories, not the shared selected date range. No start/end are passed; that is explicitly disclosed, not a missing selected-range bound bug. No duplicate local range/vehicle selector. Do not enable a misleading header range or silently filter one loaded page. Server ordering, row-cap enforcement and range handler behavior remain unexercised.

Available histories are independently retained. Both failed without retained data can be fatal; one successful source prevents whole-page fatal replacement; pending neighbor remains distinct. Refresh errors/paused sources have individual retry. New root caveat preserves cap/no-qualified/thin-support notices for fatal/refresh/paused source-status replacement. Remaining offline accounting and pending-neighbor caveat defects are CSQA-01 and CSQA-07.

All fifteen domain shells are invoked regardless of vehicle/data state, and methodology always renders. Section interiors distinguish no vehicle, initial loading, fatal, unresolved, returned-empty, no-qualified, no-cycles and no-turning-points. Coverage/continuity/support/accounting use requirement=none; cycle charts/directory/composition require cycles and point chart requires turning points. Alternative-table state divergence is separately recorded in CSQA-03.

Human labels/help/disclosures/actions use t with fallbacks; source/band/duration names have label adapters. Numeric helper uses Intl locale and global precision for ordinary numbers. Directory memoization follows formatter preference updates; duration uses the existing formatter and date rendering includes vehicle timezone. Technical drive/charging/start/end identities, table/chart IDs, month keys, EFC, d^exponent and percent-band notation are not automatically i18n failures. Catalog keys, plural coverage, effective locale/12-hour preferences and fresh locale rendering were not validated. Specialist percent precision remains a candidate, not an invented translation failure.

findings.mechanism: Accounting passes retained only from state.refreshError. cycleStressQueryState has no paused/offline field in its flat state and does not synthesize an error for isRefreshBlocked. With cached paused data, the summary checks hasData plus refreshError/isRefreshBlocked, but accounting passes false; BatteryEvidenceBrief then labels its retained readings 'Available source readings'.
findings.minimalFixScope: Page-local orchestration and modernization accounting props: pass the same per-source hasData/refreshError/isRefreshBlocked retained decision used by Summary. Keep counts, payloads, keys, retry and request policies unchanged.

findings.mechanism: The accounting cells correctly render an unavailable/pending source as em dash, but the numeric brief context interpolates drive.returnedRows and charging.returnedRows unconditionally. Root substitutes an empty array while that source has no payload, so the detail context can state 'available data: 0 drives + N charging' for a drive request that has never established a count. The known-returned subtotal itself is valid; the per-source zero context is not.
findings.minimalFixScope: Accounting context only: use the existing unavailable booleans to interpolate a localized unknown/pending source count instead of zero, while preserving real successful empty counts, known-source subtotal, eight category rows and the returned=included+excluded invariant.

findings.mechanism: Five chart adapters always pass nonempty model-generated bin/sensitivity rows as ChartContainer data, even when neither source has resolved or a vehicle is absent. Their visible CycleStressSectionBody rejects that state, and exports are disabled, but ChartContainer's hasFallbackTable checks only data length and column length; its screen-reader/forced-colors table independently renders those rows. Consequently alternative users can receive zero counts/index readings while the visible body says no vehicle/loading/failure. Disabling export does not suppress the alternative table.
findings.minimalFixScope: The five local chart adapters: feed empty alternative data until the same vehicle/resolved/error/evidence predicate used by the visible cycle body admits actual reconstructed-cycle evidence; provide the matching localized state description. Preserve valid zero-valued bins when cycles exist, all chart shells/series, raw rows and exports. Existing shared props suffice; no shared ChartContainer edit is necessary.
findings.limit: Proven source render branch mismatch, not a fresh screen-reader/OS high-contrast capture.

findings.mechanism: Coverage, continuity, composition and support use normal MetricCards without compact/wrapLabel/wrapSubtitle. The current shared card defaults labels and captions to truncate. Full source dates, paired cap statuses, diagnostic thresholds and translated captions therefore lack a caller-provided complete visible presentation when their card width is insufficient. Current shared wrapSubtitle is already available, so the historical need for a new shared subtitle API is obsolete.
findings.minimalFixScope: Four local diagnostic card callers: adopt existing compact presentation or appropriate complete wrapping with wrapSubtitle and label treatment. Keep full caption text and numeric semantics; no shared API expansion, shortening or removal of source metadata.

findings.rule: Mission preserve behavior / truthful reconstruction limits
findings.mechanism: Subtitle promises that no range can cross a rejected overlap. buildIntervals classifies and skips overlaps without emitting a segmentation marker. buildObservationSegments sees accepted intervals only and starts a segment solely for first interval, gap > threshold or endpoint jump > threshold. A rejected overlap is therefore not independently a continuity fence; accepted neighbors that meet both thresholds can remain in one segment. This proves the stated guarantee exceeds the implementation, not that the entire rainflow algorithm is invalid.
findings.minimalFixScope: Clarify this local subtitle to distinguish exclusion of overlapping rows from actual gap/jump segmentation. Corresponding catalog wording belongs to its separately authorized owner. Introducing an overlap fence would change modeled behavior and needs an explicit domain decision and later tests; do not silently change the model under a copy fix.

findings.mechanism: Ordinary support diagnostics assign purple/cyan/green/blue/amber/red by card position. Coverage, continuity and composition similarly use many hues, and section icons use fixed text-cyan-300. Shared MetricCard uses the selected color map on icon foregrounds even though its surface/value text is neutral. Colors therefore emphasize routine diagnostics without corresponding warning/error semantics and fixed icon colors bypass theme-adaptive foreground roles.
findings.minimalFixScope: Local diagnostic icon/card presentation across coverage/continuity/composition/support and related section icons. Prefer neutral token foregrounds and reserve restrained semantic emphasis for actual warnings/boundaries. Preserve chart source/series identity and user theme/palette persistence; no global token reset.
findings.limit: Contract/presentation source finding, not measured contrast failure or fresh visual rejection.

findings.mechanism: The new root caveat is enabled only for fatalError/refreshError/isRefreshBlocked. If one source has successfully reached its cap while the other is ordinarily pending, none of those flags is required. SourceStatus delegates to QueryStatus, which returns its partial-source notice at lines 110-143 before evaluating the cap at 146-152. Thus the summary's co-located cap caveat is still omitted for ordinary pending-neighbor partial evidence. Coverage/methodology retain cap disclosures elsewhere; this is not whole-page loss and does not negate the new retained/failure/paused fixes.
findings.minimalFixScope: Root caveat composition or the local query-status presenter: include resolved available evidence with pending/failed neighbors when a cap/qualification/support caveat applies, without duplicate normal notices or changes to retry policies, queries, caps or analysis.
